[[File:Imperial_Kolto_Refining_Platform.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The [[Imperial Kolto Refining Platform]]]]
The '''Nautical Mining System''' was a network of floating platforms designed for efficient [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. Developed by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Seeral Korrd]] and his engineering team, the system allows for the rapid deployment of mining stations that can be quickly constructed and moved, minimizing casualties and resistance during operations.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Nautical Mining System}}</ref>
